sections.text: Introduction

This document lists the 
equipment inspection I4, of emergency diesel engine, which must be performed 
every 2500-operation hr base as indicated by H 2500 in the title block.

The first draft initiated 
by eng.: Hesham M. Hassan, reviewed by Maintenance director: eng. Saad Mostafa, 
revised by eng.: Samir Abdel-Gelil at EDEPCo., accepted by maintenance general 
director: eng. Ali Mostafa Al-lithy, and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head 
Sector of TALKHA steam power station 2 x 210 MW.
Safety Precautions
Work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Before isolated the diesel engine 
mechanically and electrically

The 
engine must be operated and check the following steps and reads all the 
available record values and putted in operation & maintenance record data sheet

rows:
Check the 
 oil level in the tank.

Check the 
 fuel level in the fuel tank

Check the 
 compression pressures in the individual cylinders

Check the 
 uniform power distribution on cylinders.

Check any 
 leakage from the piping connections to the diesel engine or its accessories 
 (water, lube oil, fuel, and air).

Check (by 
 listening) the regular operation of the engine and whether there is no 
 abnormal sounds or knocks.

Check 
 whether there are no heavy knocks in the injection valve pipe.

Check the 
 operation of suction and exhaust valves, check the condition of the valve 
 springs.

Check (by 
 touch) the crankshaft and camshaft bearings temperature rise on the case 
 covers of the cylinder blocks, at the points where the bearings are 
 located.

Check the 
 starting valves for tightness by touching the starting air pipes heating on 
 cylinder heads.

 .

Remove the cylinder heads and

sections.text: The Pistons and piston rings

Dismantle the pistons and remove 
 piston rings.

Carry out a visual inspection of the 
 pistons and clean them of carbon.

Clean carefully seized parts of 
 pistons with a smooth file.

Clean also the grooves of the piston 
 rings of carbon.

Check the rings wear, measure the 
 clearance in the piston ring lock , with the ring inserted into the cylinder 
 liner.

- Care is to be taken that the rings 
 are measured always in the cylinder in which they were run -in.

Change the upper rings with the 
 lower ones. If the clearance of the two upper 
 rings is larger than the wear limit {See table of clearance Table(1)}.

Check scraper 
 rings wear during operation which causes increasing in the oil consumption.

Uncouple the fuel 
injection pump from the fuel injection valves and close it tightly. (recommended 
to use a plug screw for this propose)

Take out the pump by 
hand by means of the lever supplied with the engine tools.

Fit the lever into the 
hole in the tappet guide body above the fuel injection pump tappet.

If there is a hard 
resistance, it is a sign that the piston clearance is correct.

If there is a soft 
resistance, (with the lever slowly dropping), it is a sign that the piston 
clearance is large and piston must be replaced.
